brief:
The United Nations has warned of escalating food insecurity across 16 global crisis zones, including Sudan and Yemen, the Shehab Wire reported. The alert covers multiple conflict-affected and fragile regions facing compounded crises.

Gaza faces an ongoing acute hunger emergency, with 67 percent of the population experiencing crisis-level food insecurity or worse, according to UN assessments. The territory remains among the world's most severe hunger situations.
